bugs_found_and_fixed.what: Cat J/Z (2% NI), B (1.85%), V (veteran ER) all silently treated as cat A; Z employer NI charged 15% from ST
NI annualised (annual/ppy) instead of HMRC published period thresholds (PT 1,048 not 1,047.50; UEL 4,189 not 4,189.17; weekly 242 not 241.73; ST 417/96): 1-4p per line

Tax code allowance was N*10; HMRC uses N*10+9 (1257L free pay 12,579; monthly 1,048.25). Also taxable pay not floored to whole pounds nor bands rounded up. Monthly 3,000 gave 390.50 vs HMRC 390.20; weekly 500 gave 51.65 vs 51.60

Higher-rate band ended at taxable 112,570 (75% of the way to the additional rate) - anyone with taxable pay 112,570-125,140 (gross ~116.8k-125.1k) was taxed 45% instead of 40%. Correct limit is taxable 125,140
Automatic £100k personal-allowance taper applied by the engine; PAYE follows the code (HMRC reissues a lower code) so the engine mis-stated tax for 100k+ earners on 1257L
S-prefix (Scottish) codes had the prefix stripped and used rUK bands; Emp.taxRegime ignored. D2/D3/SD* codes unhandled
Student/postgraduate loans never deducted though Emp.studentLoanPlan exists (field only)
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: auto '__studentloan' post-tax deduction; UI select added to employee editor
